title: 第1章 这究竟是什么地方？！
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“四臂尸皇在上，额，不，伪帝...也、也不对。总之，神皇在上啊，我想去的是泰拉不是泰拉！您可千万别给我拉您那儿去了！”

荒漠。一望无际的荒漠。

像西部老片里的戈壁，但多了电影永远给不了你的绝望。

已经在这鬼地方游荡了近两天的寓乐，再也坚持不住，膝盖一软跪在了地上。

他就记得自己在家刷视频，刷累了，睡觉。

一睁眼就在这儿了。

大型真人秀？做梦？还是...真特么穿越了？

就因为我不仅是云锤还在使用憎恶智能美美出图女版帝皇？所以黄皮子把我弄泰拉了？

这也太特么离谱了！

但看着眼前一望无际的戈壁，寓乐又觉得好像也没那么奇怪。

可就算真拉泰拉去了，也不能把我丢废土啊！

这鬼地方，没水没吃的，昼夜温差大得吓人。

老实说，他还能撑到现在没出严重问题，自己都惊讶。

不知道是上天垂怜，还是渴出幻觉了。

前方突然出现几个人影。

寓乐一愣，随即大喜过望，朝前方狂奔而去。

饥渴、绝望在这一刻一扫而空。

他知道这可能太冒进了。但头顶的炙热和虚弱的身体告诉他，再拖下去，真的会死！

寓乐边跑边高声呼喊，试图引起对方注意。

可跑着跑着，寓乐脸色一变，猛地刹住了脚步。

对方朝他举起了疑似枪的东西。

他不确定那到底是不是枪，那玩意枪口粗得过头，充满了粗制滥造的感觉。

比起军工产品，这东西更像是绿皮科技。

但正因为像绿皮科技，寓乐才真不敢动了。

对方掏把M4出来，说不定还是玩具。可几根生锈的铁管子鼓捣出来的玩意儿...

他觉得还是别赌的好。

“我没有恶意！我只是太渴了，迷路了，看见你们太兴奋了！”

说到最后，寓乐的声音卡了一下。

因为他看清了对方的样子。

身高不对。

寓乐一米七八，已经算高的了。

但对方人均两米开外。衣服也简陋得不像话，身后拉着的更不是他最初以为的小推车。

而是一个悬浮的、充满科技和废土风的、鬼知道是什么的东西！

不会真给我干泰拉了吧？

寓乐浑身冰凉。

对面那几个人，或者说人形生物也在打量他。

离得更近了，他才看清更多细节：

他们身上的“衣服”与其说是衣物，不如说是用不知名兽皮和废金属片拼凑的护甲。裸露的皮肤上还有着不知道是涂上去还是本来就有的蓝色条纹。

总之，标准的废土客。

唯一让寓乐欣慰的是，对方至少看着的确是个人。

虽然长得粗糙，但面相上是个人样，不是绿皮之类的玩意儿。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"The Four-Armed Corpse Emperor is on top, uh, no, the false emperor...that's not right either. In short, the God Emperor is on top, I want to go to Terra, not Terra! Don't let me drag you there!"

desert.Endless desert.

It's like the Gobi Desert in old western movies, but with the added despair that movies can never give you.

Yule, who had been wandering in this hellish place for nearly two days, could no longer hold on, and his knees went weak and he knelt on the ground.

He just remembered that he was watching videos at home, and when he got tired, he went to bed.

It was here as soon as I opened my eyes.

A big reality show?dream?Or...really traveled through time?

Just because I'm not only Yunzui, but I'm also using Hate Intelligence to create beautiful pictures of the female version of the Emperor?So Huangpizi got me into trouble?

This is too outrageous!

But looking at the endless desert in front of him, Yule felt that it wasn't that strange.

But even if La Terra is really gone, I can't be thrown into the wasteland!

In this damn place, there is no water or food, and the temperature difference between day and night is terrifying.

To be honest, he was surprised that he could survive without serious problems.

I don’t know if it’s because God is showing mercy or because I’m thirsty and hallucinating.

Several figures suddenly appeared in front of them.

Yule was stunned for a moment, then he was overjoyed and ran towards the front.

Hunger, thirst, and despair were all gone at this moment.

He knew this might be too adventurous.But the scorching heat above his head and his weak body told him that if he delayed any longer, he would really die!

Yu Le ran and shouted loudly, trying to attract the other party's attention.

But as he ran, Yule's expression changed and he suddenly stopped.

The other person raised what appeared to be a gun towards him.

He wasn't sure whether it was a gun or not. The muzzle of the thing was too thick and it felt crudely made.

This thing is more like green leather technology than a military product.

But precisely because of the green-skin technology, Yule really didn’t dare to move.

The other party took out an M4, maybe it was still a toy.But something tinkered with from a few rusty iron pipes...

He thought it would be better not to gamble.

"I didn't mean any harm! I was just thirsty, lost, and so excited to see you guys!"

At the end of the sentence, Yule's voice got stuck.

Because he saw the other person's appearance clearly.

The height is wrong.

Yule is 1.78 meters tall, which is already considered tall.

But the opponent is two meters away.The clothes were too shabby, and the cart he was pulling behind him was not the cart he initially thought.

Rather, it is a suspended thing, full of technology and wasteland style, who knows what!

You won’t really fuck Terra for me, right?

Yu Le felt cold all over.

The people, or humanoids, across from him were also sizing him up.

As he got closer, he could see more details:

The "clothes" on their bodies were not so much clothing as armor pieced together from unknown animal skins and scrap metal pieces.There are still blue stripes on the exposed skin, whether it's painted on or whether it's already there.

In short, a standard wastelander.

The only thing that made Yu Le happy was that at least the other person looked like a human being.

Although he looks rough, his face looks like a human being, not a green-skinned thing.
